profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is a public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and a registration on SEC EDGAR under CIK 0001963685. Its listed website is rolls-royce.com, and the text drawn from that site describes Rolls-Royce as a developer and deliverer of complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, saying it has been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. The site text also cites a £300 million investment in UK manufacturing and engineering facilities, a completed $1 billion investment in Indiana, a stated intent with Reliance Industries to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, and cooperation with the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies.

The held facts record no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for this company. Its law exposure is recorded in Nevada with a count of zero.
